findings.title: PR head adds a gofmt violation to base_test.go; CI 'Code fmt check' step fails
findings.evidence: gofmt -l ./pkg ./cmd ./api with the CI-pinned Go 1.24.12 gofmt lists pkg/ddc/alluxio/operations/base_test.go at head and nothing at base. The three added lines (2 comment lines + func decl) carry a stray leading tab. Real CI (GitHub API, 2026-11-06): Project Check run 27689217718 at head failed in lint job 82040982357 at step 'Code fmt check'; the same workflow is green on master. results/ci-fmt-differential.txt, results/F1-head.txt.

findings.title: Initial hypothesis that transform_fuse.go keeps the fmt check red on base — refuted as a gofmt version artifact
findings.evidence: The go1.27 gofmt on the review machine flags pkg/ddc/thin/transform_fuse.go on base and master, but the CI-pinned gofmt (Go 1.24.12 at this PR's base; 1.25.12 on current master) lists nothing on either — and master's Project Check is green (run 41834068553). So this is not a violation under the current CI contract and does not contribute to the PR's red CI. Retained as a forward-compat note: a future GO_VERSION bump past the newer gofmt rules will newly flag transform_fuse.go. results/F2-context-master.txt, results/ci-fmt-differential.txt.
